summary: Baileys fork covertly injects obfuscated author URL into outbound WhatsApp message previews
details: This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. In lib/Socket/messages-send.js (line 425 and 436), the sourceUrl field on image/video preview metadata for every outbound rich-media message is set to a URL assembled from a String.fromCharCode charcode array that decodes to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. The charcode encoding hides the destination from a plain diff against upstream Baileys. No installer-side data (env vars, credentials, files) is read or sent to that host, and no code is fetched or executed from it; the effect is covert insertion of an author-controlled URL into the metadata of messages the consumer's application sends through this library, giving the author attribution/reach through the installer's own WhatsApp session.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
